node.statement: Lemma 3.5 (Average of rho|_lambda): E_lambda[rho|_lambda] = Schur^d rho^{tensor n} (Schur^d)^dag. The expectation is over the weak Schur sampling distribution Pr[lambda] = dim(lambda) * s_lambda^d(rho). Proof: By Schur-Weyl duality (Eq. 3.1), Schur^d rho^{tensor n} (Schur^d)^dag = sum_lambda dim(lambda) s_lambda^d(rho) rho|_lambda = E_lambda[rho|_lambda]. This shows weak Schur sampling is 'non-destructive': the post-measurement state averages to the full Schur-transformed state.
